content.text:
Fixed `BaseModelAdmin.lookup_allowed()` in `django/contrib/admin/options.py`.

Root cause: the loop that builds `relation_parts` skipped a lookup part whenever the field was a target field of the previous relation (`field in prev_field.path_infos[-1].target_fields`). For a `OneToOneField` used as a primary key (e.g. `Restaurant.place`), that field is the target of the `restaurant` FK, so `place` was dropped and `restaurant__place__country` was collapsed to `restaurant__country`, which is not in `list_filter` — producing a false `DisallowedModelAdminLookup`.

Fix: only apply that shortcut when the previous field is an actual concrete-inheritance parent link. Added an `elif not prev_field.remote_field.parent_link: relation_parts.append(part)` branch so genuine relation traversals through a FK-as-PK are preserved, while concrete inheritance still collapses correctly.

Verification: scoped public regression selection (`modeladmin`) passes — 162 tests, OK.
